title: Dong Won Jeon's Paper Was Published in Advanced Materials (IF: 29.1) and Selected for the Back Cover!
text: His paper, “Closed-Loop Solid-State Synthesis Planning for Materials Discovery With Large Language Models,” was published in Advanced Materials (IF: 29.1) and has been selected for the journal’s Back Cover. Congratulations! DOI: 10.1002/adma.74502

title: M-Square Wins the Track 1 Top Excellence Award at the 2026 AI Co-Scientist Challenge Korea 🏆
text: The M-Square team won the Track 1 Top Excellence Award at the 2026 AI Co-Scientist Challenge Korea! Their work on “An AI-Guided Framework for Mobility–Stability-Aware Recipe Generation in Oxide Semiconductor TFTs” earned the team this honor. Congratulations!
